author: Mark Atwood
text: Security pass on tpcn fix (kimi-k3) adds two vectors not explicit here: (1) 2>"$W_ERR" redirect (fleet-guards.sh:125) follows a pre-planted fleet_burn.err SYMLINK -> clobbers/truncates any victim-owned file every cycle (no noclobber, only set -u); (2) W_HINT=$(tail -n 1 "$W_ERR") (:127) echoes attacker-chosen content unsanitized into operator logs (:130) — control-sequence injection. Also: path is shared with fleet-headless.sh:23 and fleet-driver.sh:61,159,214, so the mode-0700 home-dir move must migrate ALL consumers together.
